body.name: Empirical-oracle boundary handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{fin}}\): couple the exact score ordering on \(\Omega_T\) to the Gaussian quadratic ordering at the realized \(G_T(\beta)\); control thin-boundary probabilities and score-weighted truncated moments jointly; then insert exact first- and second-order inclusion probabilities into the Horvitz--Thompson covariance identity.
